name: roughcut
description: First-draft video editor driven by your Claude agent. Two modes: doc/interview and multicam podcast. Bundles ffmpeg + Python 3.11 + all deps; no Terminal required.
long_description: Point roughcut at a folder of interview footage and a folder of b-roll. The agent picks the cleanest takes, decides where b-roll fits, and writes a Premiere / DaVinci Resolve project file. roughcut does the deterministic work (transcribe, cluster takes, contact-sheet frames, build FCPXML); your Claude subscription pays for the reasoning. macOS Apple Silicon only.

tools.name: list_clips
tools.description: Inventory video files in a folder via ffprobe.

tools.name: transcribe_video
tools.description: Local mlx-whisper transcription with word timestamps.

tools.name: cluster_takes_by_silence
tools.description: Group transcript segments by silence boundaries.

tools.name: align_takes_to_script
tools.description: Fuzzy-match transcript segments against script lines.

tools.name: extract_frame_grid
tools.description: Sample frames from a clip into a contact sheet.

tools.name: get_clip_thumbnail
tools.description: Extract one frame at a specific timecode.

tools.name: generate_fcpxml
tools.description: Write FCPXML v1.10 to disk from a SequenceSpec.

tools.name: detect_multicam_groups
tools.description: Group simultaneously-recorded clips by audio sync.

tools.name: diarize_speakers
tools.description: Per-segment speaker labels via mic RMS dominance.

tools.name: pick_angle_per_segment
tools.description: Pick camera angle per segment with reaction shots.

tools.name: generate_multicam_fcpxml
tools.description: Write FCPXML from an AngleSelection list.

tools.name: get_project_paths
tools.description: Return the user-configured interview, b-roll, and script paths.

interview_folder.title: Interview footage folder
interview_folder.description: Folder containing your sit-down / talking-head clips. Used by the get_project_paths tool so the agent doesn't have to ask each session.

broll_folder.title: B-roll folder
broll_folder.description: Folder containing supporting visuals (cutaways, archival footage). Optional.

script_path.title: Script (.txt or .md)
script_path.description: Plain-text script the agent will align takes against. Skip if you have no script — the agent will cluster by silence instead.
